title: fix: pin Mistral and Llama Scout routes
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Pins `mistral` to OpenRouter Mistral with provider fallback disabled.
- Pins `llama-scout` to OpenRouter DeepInfra FP8 with provider fallback disabled.
- Reduces Mistral’s declared reference-image limit from 10 to the exact route’s limit of 8.
- Preserves canonical names, aliases, capabilities, paid-only access, and verified price sheets.

Tests: gen typecheck; model resolver 41/41; Enter pricing/registry invariants 381/381; local E2E 35/35.

gist.headline: Models, stay on route
gist.blurb: Mistral and Llama Scout have been given their own well-marked garden paths. Fewer surprise detours, and Mistral now brings exactly eight reference images to the picnic.
gist.summary: Pinned `mistral` to OpenRouter Mistral and `llama-scout` to OpenRouter DeepInfra FP8 with provider fallback disabled, while aligning Mistral’s reference-image limit from 10 to 8.
gist.impact: Requests for these canonical models now resolve to their verified routes with predictable capabilities, pricing, and an accurate eight-image Mistral limit.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a tiny railway conductor in a cozy code-garden, guiding two labeled model trains onto clearly marked routes: Mistral toward an OpenRouter station and Llama Scout toward a DeepInfra FP8 station. Eight small reference-image tiles sit neatly beside the Mistral platform, while a CRT monitor robot happily verifies the route map among flowers and code-plants.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny conductor hat, guiding two small model trains onto tidy garden railway tracks labeled "MISTRAL" and "LLAMA SCOUT"; a friendly CRT monitor robot checks a route map beside exactly eight little image tiles, with flowers and code-plants around the stations. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
